blocking_findings.detail: Denied license under the permissive-only policy. Per depscan-supplychain-audit Step 6, a denied/unknown license is an unconditional BLOCK condition — there is no pre-existing carve-out. Pre-dates this PR (not introduced by it) and is tracked in issue #58, but still blocks merge until resolved or the policy is explicitly overridden by a human.

Plain-HTTP, non-allowlisted repository declared in pom.xml. Per depscan-supplychain-audit Step 6, an artifact source from an untrusted/HTTP repository is an unconditional BLOCK condition. Pre-dates this PR (not introduced by it) and is tracked in issue #21, but still blocks merge until removed/replaced.
